description: Send a message to a channel or thread. It can carry text, embeds, a poll, files from the local machine, a reply to an existing message, stickers (up to 3) and flags (suppress embeds, silent). At least one of content, embeds, sticker_ids, files or poll is required. Mentions do not ping unless allowed_mentions permits it. To change a message already sent use discord_edit_message. A retry without the same nonce posts a second message. Bot permissions it may need: View Channel, Send Messages, Attach Files, Embed Links, Send Polls, Send TTS Messages, Read Message History, Send Messages in Threads, Use External Stickers, Mention Everyone. Changes Discord data and is not idempotent; check the result before retrying.

allowed_mentions.description: Allowed mentions object controlling which role, user, or @everyone pings produce notifications; defaults to no pings

parse.description: Allowed mention types to parse from message text: 'roles', 'users', or 'everyone'

replied_user.description: Whether to mention the author of the message being replied to; defaults to false

roles.description: Array of role IDs that can be mentioned in message content (up to 100)

items.description: Discord snowflake ID as a numeric string

users.description: Array of user IDs that can be mentioned in message content (up to 100)

items.description: Discord snowflake ID as a numeric string

channel_id.description: ID of the channel or thread to send the message in

embeds.description: Up to 10 rich embed objects; text across all embeds is limited to 6000 characters. Each object takes Discord embed fields such as title, description, url, color (integer), fields, author, footer, image and thumbnail

files.description: Local files to upload as message attachments

items.description: Local file upload specification with path and optional metadata

content_type.description: MIME type of the file; detected from the file content when omitted

description.description: Accessibility alt-text description for the attachment (up to 1024 characters)

filename.description: Override filename sent to Discord; defaults to the basename of path

is_spoiler.description: Whether to mark the attachment as a spoiler; defaults to false

path.description: Absolute path of the file to upload. Hidden files and folders are refused unless DISCORD_MCP_FILE_ROOTS is set

title.description: Display title for the uploaded file

flags.description: Message flags bitfield. 4 suppresses link embeds, 4096 sends without push or desktop notifications; add them to set both (4100). No other flags are accepted.

message_reference.description: Message reference object for replying to an earlier message

fail_if_not_exists.description: Whether to fail sending if the referenced message does not exist (default true)

message_id.description: ID of the original message being replied to

nonce.description: Pass the nonce from an uncertain result to retry without a duplicate

poll.description: Poll to create with the message

allow_multiselect.description: Whether voters can select more than one answer (default false)

answers.description: Between 1 and 10 possible answers for voters to choose from

poll_media.description: Answer choice display content (text and optional emoji)

emoji.description: Optional emoji display for the answer

id.description: ID of a custom guild emoji

name.description: Unicode emoji character or custom emoji name

duration.description: Poll duration in hours up to 32 days (768 hours; default is 24 hours)

layout_type.description: Poll layout type (1 for standard default poll layout)

sticker_ids.description: Array of up to 3 sticker IDs to attach to the message

tts.description: Whether this message should be spoken using text-to-speech (default false)
